classification.vuln_type: assert-abort (out-of-range TEID used as array index)

trigger.message: PFCP Session Establishment Request with F-TEID inside Create PDR carrying a TEID outside the local PDR TEID pool range
trigger.field: F-TEID.teid value. open5gs uses the attacker-supplied TEID directly as a pool array index, then asserts at lib/pfcp/context.c:1147 that it lies in (0, pool.size]. PB1 'Invalid Value' (ID outside valid range, used directly as lookup key).
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established (issue's pcap shows Assoc Setup before the malicious SER)

ground_truth.crash_type: reachable assertion: `pdr->f_teid.teid > 0 && pdr->f_teid.teid <= ogs_pfcp_pdr_teid_pool.size' failed -> abort (core dumped)

root_cause.note: DISTINCT FROM OPEN5GS-PFCP-018 (#3747): same crash function (`ogs_pfcp_pdr_swap_teid`) and same assertion text, but DIFFERENT assert call site — 019 fires at line 1147 (non-restoration path), 018 fires at line 1365 (restoration path with PFCPSEReqFlags.RESTI=1). Per dataset dedup convention, function + line + crash_type disambiguate; this counts as a separate bug.
